hotels.title: Stylish East Taipei Stay with Contemporary Hyatt Centric Flair
hotels.description: Set in Taipei’s East District, this polished address places you near boutique-lined lanes, late-night bars and the creative energy of Songshan Cultural and Creative Park. Taipei 101 and the leafy paths of Daan Forest Park are a short MRT ride away. Inside, expect contemporary rooms, a fitness centre and a restaurant serving Taiwanese and international dishes. Nearby, Raohe Street Night Market tempts with pepper buns, oyster omelettes and steaming bowls of beef noodle soup
